title: Clinical Course, Molecular Remission, and Quality of Life under Pegylated Interferons in Patients with Polycythemia Vera and Essential Thrombocythemia – A Multicentric Long-Term Observation
summary: Long-acting interferons are approved for the treatment of PV and ET, but current evidence is largely based on registration trials with limited applicability to routine clinical practice. To address this gap, retrospective real-world data are analyzed to evaluate effectiveness, safety, and factors influencing treatment response.

interventions.name: Retrospective analysis of patients with confirmed polycythemia vera or essential thrombocythemia receiving treatment with pegylated interferons in real-world

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Confirmed polycythemia vera or essential thrombocythemia based on the WHO/ICC 2022 criteria
Treatment duration with ropeginterferon alfa-2b or peginterferon alfa-2a of at least more than 6 months
Exclusion criteria:
Treatment duration with ropeginterferon alfa-2b or peginterferon alfa-2a of less than 6 months
